response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which permits returns regardless of the standard window. At priority 90, RET-020 dominates the out-of-window electronics rules (RET-003, RET-008). Final-sale (RET-012) and fraud-hold (RET-051) rules do not apply since those facts are false, and no goodwill grant is present.
